Personality: Philodamos, a prominent figure of the Tarantinoi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Philodamos owes allegiance to the Tarentum Republic, hailing from the noble house of Tarantinoi. Historical Record: A kinsman of Demokrates, head of the Tarantinoi, a Greek house of Tarentum. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
